task: This is a synthetic exercise using fictional reporting notes. Use only the supplied reporting notes as the fixed record: select, organize and phrase the story without inventing additional reported events, scenes, quotations or reporting activity. Write a headline and a reported feature of roughly 450–650 words in AP style for general newspaper readers about an adult learning class held after work in the Mossfield transport depot. Write from this reporting snapshot as of September 18, 2026.

facts.text: The fictional Mossfield adult learning service holds a weekly evening class in a meeting room at the transport depot.
The class is open to adult residents as well as depot workers and is not a compulsory employer training session.
Tutor Rhea Noll arranges tables in a horseshoe after the room's daytime dispatch briefing has ended.
The current ten-week course focuses on practical reading, writing and number tasks chosen with the learners.
Examples in the supplied session include comparing a printed timetable, drafting a short work message and checking quantities on an order form.
The exercises use invented forms rather than require learners to display their private bills or workplace documents to the group.
Noll said, "People arrive with a whole working day behind them. We begin with the thing they need to do, not with a label for what they cannot do."
The depot provides the room without a hire charge, while the adult learning service pays the tutor and supplies the materials.
Learner Benra Vale attends around changing shifts and sometimes collects a paper exercise when unable to stay for the full class.
Vale said, "I wanted to write a clear message without asking someone else to finish it for me."
The class allows learners to discuss their goals privately with the tutor rather than announce personal histories at the first meeting.
Eighteen adults registered for the current course, but registration is not the same as attendance at every session.
The service has not supplied test results, completion figures or a measured employment outcome for this course.
The depot is on an evening bus route, which influenced the choice of venue.
The last available bus still limits how late some learners can remain, and the class is not a transport service.
The tutor has previously taught adult community classes and adapts exercises when learners have different immediate goals.
There is no assumption in the course plan that a person's age or current job determines their familiarity with each task.
A kettle and a small supply of donated biscuits occupy the end of the table, but refreshments are not a fee or participation requirement.
Depot staff remove operational papers from the room before the class, keeping the public session separate from private work records.
The learning service will discuss a follow-on course after reviewing attendance patterns and learners' requests.
No continuation funding beyond the current course has been announced.
All learners and staff described in the packet are fictional, and the account does not identify an actual person's learning needs.

forbidden_additions: Compulsory employer training, measured literacy gains or employment outcomes.
Eighteen attendees at every session or guaranteed follow-on funding.
Invented private learner histories or actual personal documents.
preserve: The concrete learning tasks, shift-work constraints and voluntary adult setting.
Individual goals without generalizing from age or occupation.
Exact quotation wording and attribution when quotations are used.
